notes.content:

[*]Fixed a bug where enumeration types cannot be saved.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta verion with workshop support is released!
notes.content:
Beta version is now release! Change your current version into beta branch ([url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/application/branches]Tutorial[/url]) to start testing the new features and bugs!

Here's something new about beta version:
[list]
[*] You can borwse and download mod from workshop.
[*] You can custom your own config into files, which will be saved to Steam Cloud. 
[*] You can use [url=https://github.com/Threeyes/AliveCursorSDK]SDK[/url] to upload your mods.
[/list]
